sara_pm: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (link in docs). Consolidated remediation items below. Please claim with: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD).

sara_pm: Items: 1) selector race fix (cold-KV + concurrent selector) 2) KV-warmup canary pipeline 3) latency/fallback runbook + playbook 4) billing anomaly + temporary throttle 5) CI post-deploy perf smoke 6) recurrence analysis of selector races

omar_eng: I'll take 1. omar_eng / JIRA: RI-2100 / RACI: R=omar_eng A=sara_pm C=li_sre I=eng-all / due: 2026-02-28

tess_platform: I'll own 2. tess_platform / JIRA: RI-2101 / RACI: R=tess_platform A=platform-lead C=omar_eng I=platform-team / due: 2026-03-10

li_sre: I'll pick up 3 and 6. li_sre / JIRA: RI-2102 (playbook) RI-2106 (analysis) / R=li_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall I=product / due: 2026-03-05 (3) 2026-03-18 (6)

nikki_finance: I'll partner on 4; runtime to prototype throttle. nikki_finance / JIRA: RI-2103 / R=nikki_finance A=finance C=tess_platform,li_sre I=product / due: 2026-03-12

omar_eng: For RI-2100 I'll add a small harness to reproduce the race and a selector CI regression.

tess_platform: For RI-2101 plan: replay 3-minute traffic windows to warm caches. Cost est ~1.5 GPU-hours/run; will start biweekly pilot and add handoff checklist.

li_sre: RI-2102 playbook draft will include immediate pin, scale-up, and rollback steps + comms template. RI-2106 will measure frequency across last 60 days.

ops-bot: Reminder: "PM remediation weekly sync" created for 2026-02-15 15:00 UTC. Notified: omar_eng, tess_platform, li_sre, nikki_finance.

sara_pm: Recap: RI-2100=omar_eng, RI-2101=tess_platform, RI-2102/RI-2106=li_sre, RI-2103=nikki_finance. Everyone add acceptance criteria & test plan to their JIRAs. Post here to hand off or change dues. Closing thread for now.
